title: Nebula Fields
description: Rolling moss islands under forests of giant glowing Lumineshrooms.

title: Aurora Shallows
description: Pale, flat shelves under green and gold auroras.

title: The Corona
description: Sunscorched mesas, Flarebloom fields and glowing lichen.

title: Comet Wake
description: Scorched islands pocked with impact craters.

title: Dark Matter Belt
description: Dim forests of twisted Nullwood on ring-shaped islands.

title: Shattered Observatory
description: Great rings of quartz pillars, overgrown with Starblooms.

title: Drift Whale
description: A huge, gentle whale that swims through the void.

title: Void Wanderer
description: A clockwork construct that studies you, if you hold still.

title: End Pollinator
description: A little drifter that spreads glowing plants.

title: A live comet
description: Ride its tail with an elytra, or knock a chunk off its head.

title: Wormhole Maw
description: The fossil skull of a Star Leviathan. Its throat is a way across the End.

title: Observatory Ruins
description: A broken dome, a telescope, and vaults that open for a Chart Fragment.

title: Abandoned Orrery
description: A wheel of tarnished bronze hanging high over the End, and its guardian.

title: Orrery Bronze
description: A whole block family that tarnishes over time; wax it to keep it.
